thread:
pm-liz: quick intake — AcmeHealth requested an "onboarding eval gate" to run customer prompt suites against canary and rollout models. They want automated gating (per-tenant thresholds), a human review override, and an on-demand replay for support. Need a short PRD skeleton (problem, goals, non-goals, acceptance, edge cases, rollout). Who can estimate effort? :thinking:

eng-raj: scale q — how big are suites and frequency? hosted vs in-VPC? if hosted need PII masking and retention rules.

pm-liz: they said ~1k prompts initially, then ~100s/mo. Expect a run on each canary + full rollout. Prefer VPC-hosted for sensitive tenants; hosted ok if tenant opts-in.

jia: metrics to capture: pass_rate (human-labeled), hallucination_rate, safety flags, latency_p95, token_cost_change. Need definition: binary pass vs graded? Acme will supply gold answers for ~200 prompts.

design-zoe: UX needs: single-pane report with overall pass %, failing samples with diff view, time series per deploy, and action buttons (promote/rollback). Per-tenant slider for thresholds + advanced JSON policy editor.

sam: security: do NOT send raw private prompts to hosted evals. Two modes: hosted (scrubbed + opt-in) and VPC (customer-run). KMS for persisted artifacts.

ops-jen: ops note: doing 1k prompts synchronously per deploy is risky. Recommend sampled canary sync (e.g., 50 prompts) and async full-suite post-canary with backoff and retry caps.

kevin: rough cost calc: 1k prompts * 50 tokens * $0.00001/token ~= $0.50 per run on baseline. GPUs and reruns increase cost. UI should display estimated cost and allow budget cap.

maria: suggested acceptance criteria:
```
- Canary sample run completes <5m; full async suite completes <60m
- Block rollout if pass_rate < tenant_threshold (default 95%) OR hallucination_rate increases >2% vs baseline
- Human override logged with user + reason
- Private-mode data never leaves tenant VPC
- Report shows diff + per-prompt examples
```

pm-liz: non-goals: not an auto-retrain loop, not a full annotator platform (we can offer paid labeling later). This is a production gating + observability feature.

eng-raj: impl notes: need an "eval path" that mirrors serving path (same cache/quantization) to avoid measurement bias. Expose per-request token breakdown API.

jia: edge cases: nondeterministic prompts, rate-limited prompts, token-explosion prompts, multi-turn context rules (define canonical window per tenant).

design-zoe: UX edgecases: showing probabilistic pass rates vs binary, surfacing reason categories (semantic mismatch vs hallucination) clearly.

pm-liz: rollout plan & owners:
- pm-liz: craft short PRD skeleton and link this thread
- eng-raj + ops-jen: feasibility + rough E/D estimate by EOD Thu
- jia: propose metric definitions + example calc
- design-zoe: mocks for report by next Tue
- kevin: cost-per-run breakdown + UI options

release-bot: created epic RED-1248 "onboarding-eval-gate" and linked this thread: https://redwood/epics/RED-1248

pm-liz: drop quick ack or questions. I will attach thread to PRD as evidence of customer constraints. :white_check_mark:
